newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market picked up this afternoon on a dip in the dollar coupled to calls for a firmer Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.

"Despite the absence of many operators due to the May Day public holiday in a large part of Europe the weaker dollar caused some activity this afternoon. Most of the business was nearby hand-to-mouth business.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $307.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam. July/Sept Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $146 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Arrived citruspulp pellets fetched $106 a tonne cif Rotterdam and arrived Malaysian palmkernel expellers $105.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Afloat Thai tapioca pellets changed hands between 18.90 and 19.10 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam from three different vessels.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
